source_name: Enigma Soft — Ukrainian banking-systems software provider page
why_relevant: Smaller Ukrainian supplier positioning around banking-systems software; relevant for completing the long tail of the domestic vendor map beyond CS and UNITY-BARS. Low individual value, but the tail matters for second- and third-tier Ukrainian banks whose IT choices are otherwise invisible.

source_name: Ukrainian system integrators with financial-sector practices (SI BIS, BMS Consulting, Versiya, Valtek, ITB-Systems)
why_relevant: Infrastructure integrators (data centre, information security, cloud, networks) are the delivery layer beneath core-banking and payments projects in Ukraine. SI BIS operates from Kyiv with branches in Kharkiv, Lviv, Odesa and Dnipro; BMS Consulting has documented enterprise project deliveries. Their portfolio/news pages occasionally name financial-sector clients that neither the bank nor the software vendor announces.

source_name: ProZorro central public procurement portal (prozorro.gov.ua)
why_relevant: Ukraine's mandatory e-procurement portal. Tender notices and award records for CPV/DK 021:2015 66110000-4 'Банківські послуги' expose which bank serves which ministry, municipality or SOE, at what commission, with contract end dates that are effectively renewal signals. Confirmed live examples found: acquiring, RKO (settlement-cash service), payroll servicing, QR/internet-banking payment acceptance.

source_name: OpenProcurement / ProZorro public API documentation
why_relevant: Machine-readable route into every ProZorro tender, award and contract object — the only sustainable way to build a longitudinal banking/payments contract register instead of one-off page reads.

source_name: BI Prozorro public analytics module
why_relevant: Free BI layer over all ProZorro data since 2015, refreshed daily. Lets you aggregate banking/payments spend by buyer, supplier bank, CPV and year without building your own pipeline — a fast way to size the state acquiring/RKO market and rank incumbents.

source_name: Prozorro.Sale (Прозорро.Продажі) auction system
why_relevant: State-owned e-auction system; since 2016 the sole channel for selling assets of banks in liquidation and, later, property of state banks. Reveals distressed-bank asset flows, state-bank branch/equipment disposals and buyer identities — none of which appear in annual reports.

source_name: DGF single cabinet on Prozorro.Sale (Єдиний кабінет ФГВФО)
why_relevant: Deposit Guarantee Fund's dedicated portal for liquidated-bank asset lots. Direct visibility into failed-bank estate composition, loan-portfolio sales and pricing.

source_name: Spending.gov.ua / E-Data unified public funds portal
why_relevant: Treasury-level transactions plus a contracts register — shows actual money paid under banking/payment contracts (commissions, fees), not just the awarded ceiling. Complements ProZorro's ex-ante view with ex-post execution, and names the servicing bank on payment records.

source_name: Clarity Project analytical platform
why_relevant: Aggregates 140+ state registries with ProZorro tender analytics, AMCU appeal decisions and State Audit Service monitoring against a single counterparty card. Ideal POINTER: enter a bank/PSP EDRPOU and get its full public-contract footprint, related parties and disputes.

source_name: DoZorro civic monitoring portal and tools directory
why_relevant: Transparency International Ukraine's monitoring layer over ProZorro; curates the analytics toolset and publishes investigations that flag suspect banking/IT contracts. Good for discovering additional tools, datasets and named actors.

source_name: Prozorro Infobox knowledge base
why_relevant: Official Prozorro explainer library — documents how to search tenders, how State Audit Service monitoring works, and which analytics modules exist. Methodological backbone for building a reliable collection routine and for interpreting field semantics.

source_name: SE Diia (ДП «ДІЯ») procurement page
why_relevant: The state enterprise operating the Diia ecosystem publishes its own procurements. Direct route to contracts for payment integration, acquiring and processing inside state e-services — the single most strategically relevant buyer for payments vendors in Ukraine.

source_name: Ministry of Digital Transformation (Мінцифри) — news and projects
why_relevant: Announces tenders and policy for state digital/e-service infrastructure (e.g. Diia.ID module tenders) and, since 2024, must approve informatization procurements — so its releases pre-announce demand that later shows up as ProZorro banking/payment IT lots.

source_name: Diia Center library — procurement approval rules (center.diia.gov.ua)
why_relevant: Documents the approval regime for informatization procurements (including sub-500k UAH) effective from 01.10.2024 — needed to understand which payment-IT purchases are visible in ProZorro and which are approved through a separate Mintsyfra gate.

source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (EU Official Journal supplement)
why_relevant: Publishes EU-institution and EU-funded notices, including contracts serving the EU Delegation to Ukraine and EU instruments for Ukraine. Captures cross-border banking/payment/financial-services procurement that never enters ProZorro.

source_name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal — Ukraine opportunities
why_relevant: Central EU portal listing Ukraine-facing calls and tenders; relevant where EU reconstruction/digitalisation money funds payment infrastructure or financial-sector technical assistance.

source_name: EBRD Client eProcurement Portal (ECEPP) and procurement notices
why_relevant: EBRD-financed Ukrainian client procurements (including state banks and municipal utilities that buy payment/collection services) are published via ECEPP. Names contracting entities and consultants working on Ukraine financial-sector projects.

source_name: World Bank STEP + Ukraine project procurement plans (Documents & Reports)
why_relevant: Ukraine project procurement plans are set out in STEP and published as PDFs; they explicitly state that ProZorro is used for RFQ/RFB/RFP under Bank-financed projects. Plans reveal forthcoming financial-sector and payment-system packages months before tender launch — a pipeline source.

source_name: AMCU appeals body decisions on public procurement
why_relevant: The permanent administrative collegium is the review body for procurement complaints. Its decisions on banking/acquiring lots expose disputed qualification criteria, bank-vs-bank rivalry and cancelled awards — competitive intelligence not visible in the tender record alone.

source_name: State Audit Service (Держаудитслужба, DASU) procurement monitoring conclusions
why_relevant: DASU monitors procedures via automatic risk indicators; its conclusions on banking/RKO lots flag irregular awards and can void or delay contracts, changing which bank actually gets the mandate. Monitoring notices are attached to the tender in ProZorro.

source_name: Zakupivli.pro (ProZakupivli) tender mirror and blog
why_relevant: Accredited-marketplace ecosystem site mirroring ProZorro tenders with its own search and an analytical blog (e.g. on selling state-bank property through Prozorro.Продажі). Useful as an alternate index when the central portal search is limiting.

source_name: Держзакупівлі.онлайн (dzo.com.ua) and tender.uub.com.ua mirrors
why_relevant: Accredited ProZorro marketplaces whose public tender pages are heavily indexed by search engines, making them a practical discovery route to banking-services lots (e.g. UCEQE bank RKO tender) and to buyer-organisation pages listing all of an entity's tenders.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank International AG — Investor Relations reports hub
why_relevant: RBI is the Vienna parent of Raiffeisen Bank Ukraine (~68% stake). Its annual/semi-annual/quarterly report set carries segment reporting where Ukraine appears as a country segment inside the CEE/Eastern Europe segment, plus the XLSM 'results file' with per-country P&L, loans, NPL and staff/branch counts. This is the richest structured Ukraine earnings channel outside NBU data.

source_name: RBI annual financial report PDF (example: 2022 full annual financial report)
why_relevant: Concrete example of the RBI annual financial report artefact that contains the segment note with Ukraine figures; useful as a format/anchor document for building a parser, and confirms these PDFs are mirrored on secondary Raiffeisen domains.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Ukraine (АТ «Райффайзен Банк») — official site, reporting/disclosure section
why_relevant: Local leg of the group channel: publishes separate and consolidated IFRS statements in Ukrainian (окрема фінансова звітність, консолідована фінансова звітність), quarterly IFRS packs and issuer annual information. Lets you reconcile the group's Ukraine segment numbers against local UAH statutory/IFRS numbers.

source_name: OTP Group Investor Relations — reports section
why_relevant: Budapest parent of OTP Bank Ukraine (100% owned). OTP's quarterly 'Summary of results' and interim management reports contain a dedicated per-subsidiary chapter for OTP Bank Ukraine with P&L, volumes, margins, risk cost and FX-adjusted growth — the most granular quarterly Ukraine bank earnings disclosure by any foreign parent.

source_name: OTP Bank Plc quarterly 'Summary of results' PDF series
why_relevant: The single most useful recurring artefact for Ukraine-segment earnings: stable filename convention (OTP_YYYYnQ_e_final.pdf) makes it trivially automatable, and each edition has an OTP Bank Ukraine section plus commentary on the Ukrainian bank windfall/profit tax.
